annotations.title: Choose a launch and send for review

description: Choose Free or Premium (and optionally a week, as get_launch_options names it) and send the listing for review. The person's ownership of the site must be proven first (start_ownership_check → verify_ownership), else this answers owner_unverified. MakerRadar reviews every listing before it goes live. Needs launches:write.

week.description: A week from get_launch_options (week-46-2026). Premium needs one; Free may omit it.
